research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 31 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Cincinnati Bengals +1.4 with a fair total of 48.4 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Jacksonville Jaguars pass offence vs Cincinnati Bengals pass defence, which sits +0.229 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Jacksonville Jaguars and Cincinnati Bengals have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
